summary: Install Prometheus and in prometheus.yml add a controller scrape job with metrics_path /api/v2/metrics, scheme https and a bearer token (or basic auth for a controller user); restart or POST to the reload endpoint to apply changes.
questions: How do I configure Prometheus to scrape automation controller?
How do I authenticate Prometheus to controller?

answer_card.title: Prometheus scrape config for controller
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: 'controller'
    tls_config:
      insecure_skip_verify: True
    metrics_path: /api/v2/metrics
    scrape_interval: 5s
    scheme: https
    bearer_token: <token_value>
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['<controller_host>']
```
Reload Prometheus (POST to its reload endpoint or restart) after editing.
